# Uoink 3.9.0 — Living Library and research

> A local library for the videos and podcasts you study, that any AI you use can search and cite.

Free, MIT-licensed. No account or Uoink-hosted corpus. Model dependencies can send telemetry. Made by Ryan Biddy (@replayryan), a personal side project.

## Install

Windows 10/11 only. No Mac build scheduled. Unsigned installer, about 390 MB; no admin rights needed. Windows SmartScreen will show a warning: More info → Run anyway. Installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Uoink. Sideload the browser extension from the install; Chrome Web Store listing pending. Chrome (tested); other Chromium browsers such as Edge and Brave may work but are not tested. Open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, click Load unpacked, and select %LOCALAPPDATA%\Uoink\extension. Click the puzzle-piece Extensions icon in the toolbar and pin Uoink so the Uoink button stays visible.

After updating, reload the extension once. If its ID changes to the pinned bkcapfidedhfcjpmjabeopfbcjcbmdmi, reapply extension preferences. Saved captures are unaffected.

- [Install](https://uoink.app/install): helper and extension instructions.
- [Latest release](https://github.com/ryanbiddy/uoink/releases/latest): installer and Claude Desktop .mcpb bundle.
- [Windows installer](https://github.com/ryanbiddy/uoink/releases/download/v3.9.0/Uoink-Setup-3.9.0.exe): Uoink 3.9.0.
- [3.9.0 release notes](https://github.com/ryanbiddy/uoink/releases/tag/v3.9.0): changes since the last public release, v3.7.0.
- [Changelog](https://uoink.app/changelog): dated release summaries.

## Capture and library

YouTube: timestamped transcript, screenshots, top comments, channel context, metadata. Also X video and post text, podcast RSS/Atom feeds, web articles, and Reddit threads. Capture with the YouTube button, right-click, Alt+U, or your AI agent. Files are structured Markdown plus a JSON sidecar on your own disk, indexed in one local library.

3.9.0 includes the previously unpublished Living Library work: clip search and evidence cards; standing capture for YouTube channels, YouTube playlists, and podcast RSS; MCP library search, item reads, resource templates and prompts; cited range export with speaker labels, chapters and provenance; and chapter navigation where chapters exist. Podcast transcripts enter the searchable corpus and interrupted jobs resume after restart. Feed audio stays off until Auto-ingest is enabled. Captures show toast notifications that can be muted and are suppressed during fullscreen use. Entity extraction is opt-in and off by default; the usage meter shows real Anthropic usage; the recall hook is hardened against prompt injection.

The redesigned dashboard has Library search-or-paste, Reader, Activity with a five-step capture strip, and one Settings page that saves individual preferences automatically. The extension popup and setup provide capture and connection controls. Caption rate limits no longer fail an entire YouTube capture: local transcription can use an already-downloaded model, or the missing transcript stays labeled. Requests are paced and yt-dlp is newer. Waiting, failures and cancellation remain distinct; cancellation is refused once publication starts.

Five local research playbooks cover outlier posts, transcript intelligence, comment mining, creator teardowns and repurposing over the user's own library. MCP agents can request cited packets without model or network calls. Optional ScrapeCreators discovery is off by default, uses the user's own key, and defaults to a 25-credit daily cap. Paid calls require credit confirmation and a dashboard intent or separately enabled agent discovery.

Security changes pin the extension ID and check it when minting tokens, reject scripted clicks on capture buttons, add private-network protection to supported fetch paths, scrub paths and credentials from returned and stored job errors, and confine corpus imports to the output folder's _exports directory. Requests inside yt-dlp and the browser renderer are outside the private-network checks; the local diagnostic log can retain raw tool output.

The library does not organize, file, or re-shelve itself. The Librarian only proposes; applying is off by default and its quality gate has not passed.

- [Features](https://uoink.app/features): feature details.
- [Sources](https://uoink.app/sources): capture paths.
- [How it works](https://uoink.app/how-it-works): capture to cited corpus.

## AI access

Clipboard paste with transcript and frames works with Claude and ChatGPT. Local MCP exposes 35 tools over stdio and 91 in the HTTP registry, counted from the product branch. Tested clients: Claude Desktop and Cursor. Cline and Continue are standard-stdio compatibility paths, not individually smoke-tested. Do not claim ChatGPT app MCP support. OpenAPI 3.1 bridges local agents that do not speak MCP.

- [Developers](https://uoink.app/developers): README config, .mcpb setup and tool catalog.
- [MCP](https://uoink.app/mcp): transport details and tools.
- [MCP manifest](https://uoink.app/mcp/manifest.json): all 91 tools, schemas and stdio availability.
- [Feature manifest](https://uoink.app/api/features-manifest): feature URLs and summaries.
- [Full text](https://uoink.app/llms-full.txt): setup details.

## Network calls and retention

Capture contacts source sites and can use FxTwitter for X text even when a post was not identified as truncated. Enabled subscriptions poll with automatic capture off, and connected agents can register them. Turning automatic capture off stops new starts; already-started work may finish. Stop Uoink stops polling until restart; Autostart on login controls the next Windows login. The authenticated local API can archive subscriptions; legacy feed and monitored-playlist enable controls cover only sources with those records.

X text capture defaults to true. Setting x_text_capture_enabled to false in local settings stops both syndication and FxTwitter text requests. There is no dashboard or extension toggle, and POST /settings does not accept this field. Video capture is separate.

Removing the saved Anthropic key attempts to delete the current credential, but a legacy Yoink credential or older plaintext settings entry can remain, and deletion failures can go unreported. Check Windows Credential Manager and the active profile settings; local removal does not revoke the key at Anthropic. Disconnect agents in their clients to end access.

Extension setup and previews can load remote thumbnails. After copying a completed capture, the extension opens claude.ai/new without pasting or submitting the content, even with AI off; there is no setting to disable the tab. Missing Whisper-model downloads require a per-request approval flag that a connected agent can set without a Uoink prompt. Optional speaker labeling downloads pyannote/speaker-diarization-community-1 from Hugging Face when needed and can send your Hugging Face token to huggingface.co. Supporting transcription and alignment models can also download from Hugging Face or PyTorch hosts, and language data from NLTK. The pinned pyannote-audio 4.0.7 dependency enables metrics by default, including during voice-activity detection with speaker labeling off. Uoink provides no dashboard switch; PYANNOTE_METRICS_ENABLED=false in the helper environment disables those metrics. Release checks query GitHub when the cache needs refreshing or a caller forces a check, without sending the library or installing an update.

Captures, local indexes and settings remain on disk. Logs can contain source URLs and paths. Exported files and optional mirrors create additional copies; sync software can upload them. The extension screenshot interval uses browser sync storage. Trash cleanup is attempted at startup and daily for items older than 30 days. Uninstall retains library data and credentials but removes edited topics.json routing rules. The website separately uses Vercel Web Analytics. See https://uoink.app/privacy for controls and retention details.

Connected agents can start paid Anthropic calls with the saved key when the user allows those actions, even with automatic analysis off. Relevant library text and, for research, saved discovery rows can be sent. Local MCP playbook packets make no model call.

ScrapeCreators receives the typed handle, channel ID or query only after discovery is enabled and the request authorized. Local run files store that input, request identity, normalized candidates and metrics, credit accounting, coverage, queue state and errors, including failed runs. No raw vendor responses, thumbnails or API keys are stored in these files. The daily purge removes run files older than 90 days; local playbooks may reuse eligible snapshots up to 30 days old.
